committee.sub: Morning brief · Monday 28 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend fell to $118.67 last7 from $152.67 prior7 and clicks eased to 21 from 24, yet conversions are still zero at a $5.65 CPC, so cost per lead remains undefined.

Impression share sits at 10% over 30 days with budget lost at 22% against rank lost at 73%, so the budget increase conversation stays closed while rank lost dominates; campaign status is ENABLED as intended post restructure.
/ai-automation-agency.html pulled 20 of the 41 sessions last7, close to half of all traffic, and the calculator logged its first use of the week (1 vs 0 prior7) even as total sessions dropped 33%.

AI Assistant sessions sit at 1 from chatgpt.com, down from 2 prior7, a channel that undercounts since many AI clicks land in Direct with no referrer; LinkedIn showed 1 session against 0 prior, likely still under-tagged given Chris's posting there. Organic Search grew to 12 from 9, the one unpaid signal worth trusting, though Search Console data only runs through 25 Sept, two days behind yesterday's Sun 27.

actions.text: Logo and image assets plus keyword matched RSA headlines for the currently serving ad groups are still outstanding, ship them.
Fix the homepage form so kontrolTrackLead fires on the Formspree confirm, not before it, closing the confirm-then-count gap.
RSA description D1 still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week, update it to match the current site stats.
